locationComparison.name: Kraken Cove
notes: Contains regular cave kraken whirlpools and the Kraken boss whirlpool.
Cave krakens are exclusively found in Kraken Cove.
Fairy ring AKQ is the fastest general route to the cove.

taskNotes: Cave krakens require 87 Slayer, 80 combat, and 50 Magic to be assigned.
Cave krakens are exclusively found within Kraken Cove.
Magic is required because Ranged attacks deal 1/7 normal damage and Melee cannot reach cave krakens.
Earth spells exploit the 50% elemental weakness on surfaced Cave kraken and Kraken.
Regular Cave kraken attacks are magic damage and can be protected against with Protect from Magic.
Fishing explosives cannot be used to surface regular Cave kraken whirlpools.
Regular Cave krakens have low-value drops and are usually killed only for the uncharged trident at 1/200 or collection log slots.
The Kraken boss can be killed instead on a Cave kraken task and is generally more favourable for profit because it has a generous drop table.
Kraken boss attacks are typeless magic, so damage cannot be prayed against.
Fishing explosives are recommended to instantly release the Kraken boss and can be bought from any Slayer master.
Kraken/Strategies contains the full boss method for release, instance use, inventory, and sustain.
recommendedMethod: Use magic only. Kill the Kraken boss for profit and simple boss tasks, using fishing explosives to start quickly; kill regular Cave krakens mainly for the uncharged trident or collection log.
